_note: Narration for hvac-dashboard-jobs.mp4, one line per beat, in the demo line's own ElevenLabs voice (Cassidy). HVAC is written "H-vac" so it is said as a word.
d1: This is your dashboard. Watch what happens when the phone rings.
d2: A no heat call comes in after hours. The job is created, and lands on tomorrow's schedule.
d3: Each job carries the customer, the address, and what was said on the call.
d4: More calls, more jobs. Each one goes into an open window on your calendar.
d5: And every job adds to what the system has booked for you.
d6: An estimate goes into your pipeline, so you can see what's still to be won.
d7: A caller who doesn't book is saved as a lead, with a call back task.
d8: Every job, on one screen. Aurelium Front Office, for H-vac.
